lines.say: Thursday's forecast: two deadlines, one shift, heavy group chat.
Your plan was made on a sunny Monday.
Tuesday and Wednesday: cloudy, but holding.
Shift alert. Deadline pings. The group chat.
Offload builds the plan from your notes and exam dates.
When a day goes wrong, it moves it.
It tests you as you go,
and brings topics back before they fade.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
